01 / 05

NEAR → Treasury → FLOOR
01 / ISSUE
A token with something behind it.

NEAR enters the treasury. FLOOR is issued only when the math preserves backing per token. At the demonstrated state, positive 1:1 issuance is blocked.

Inspect historical receipt
(opens a new tab)
02 / REDEEM
Leave a little. Lift the backing.

Redeem FLOOR against liquid backing through a size-dependent curve. The 20% tax parameter retains value for remaining holders. Your exact quote is calculated before review.

Inspect historical receipt
(opens a new tab)
03 / BORROW
Borrow from a lender. Not the treasury.

A lender escrows the NEAR. You lock FLOOR as collateral and receive a transferable recovery right. Treasury backing never becomes money available to lend.

Inspect historical receipt
(opens a new tab)
04 / TRANSFER
Your NFT. Your next move.

The NFT carries the right to repay and recover the collateral. Transfer it, and that right moves too. Repayment or default burns the NFT; FLOOR collateral is released.

Inspect historical receipt
(opens a new tab)
05 / CONTRIBUTE
Decisions that move real value.

Two signed council approvals executed a real Sputnik contribution. Backing increase
